title: Havells India among 8 midcap stocks that hit 52-week lows and slipped up to 15% in a month - Fresh Lows | The Economic Times
text:
On Monday, the benchmark Sensex tumbled 1,124 points to close at 72,771. Amid the sharp market sell-off, eight stocks from the BSE 150 Midcap Index touched fresh 52-week lows, hitting their lowest price levels in the past year. A 52-week low refers to the lowest price at which a stock has traded over the past year and is often used as an indicator of its recent price performance.

New 52-week low: Rs 6875| CMP: Rs 6912. In the last month, the stock fell about 15%.

New 52-week low: Rs 1074.3| CMP: Rs 1091. In the last month, the stock fell about 11%.

New 52-week low: Rs 1421.9| CMP: Rs 1422. In the last one month stock has fallen about 8%.
